انتهبن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَهَبْنَ (intahabna) /in.ta.hab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# اُنْتُهِبْنَ (untuhibna) /un.tu.hib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# اِنْتَهِبْنَ (intahibna) /in.ta.hib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
